intro.text: A skyscraper in Elendel's Fourth Octant.

description.text: The entire top storey forms one open penthouse, surrounded by windows, some with balconies, lit by crystal chandeliers and laid with red carpet.
About twenty storeys tall, it narrows as it climbs on a frame of steel girders, with decorative stonework, balconies, a coach portico at the entrance and a green out front.

items.text: Before Lady ZoBell's party in 342 PC, Waxillium Ladrian tried out Ranette's new grappling hook by climbing the tower. For the party, the penthouse was set with small glass-cased stands showing off fine samples of Allomantic metals.
